content.value_statement: Choosing an unsupported bid target can restrict delivery and waste learning data. This skill uses campaign history to build a practical bidding and learning-phase plan.
actual_capabilities: Selects tCPA, tROAS, max-conversions, max-conversion-value, or manual CPC from campaign goals and conversion history.
Derives an initial tCPA or tROAS target from recent achievable performance.
Groups compatible campaigns into bid portfolios by goal, target, and funnel stage.
Plans learning-phase entry, review timing, and changes that may reset learning.
Labels inputs as measured, user-provided, estimated, or requiring an export.
limitations: It does not allocate budgets across campaigns.
It does not monitor live pacing or make in-flight bid changes.
Reliable target recommendations require recent CPA, ROAS, value, and conversion-volume data.
Volume and learning thresholds are estimates, not platform guarantees.

use_cases.title: Launch a lead campaign
use_cases.description: Choose a starting strategy and tCPA from recent lead volume and cost history.

use_cases.title: Restructure ecommerce bidding
use_cases.description: Set an achievable tROAS and separate campaigns with incompatible revenue economics.

use_cases.title: Review agency campaign portfolios
use_cases.description: Create portfolio groups and learning-phase plans across several client campaigns.

prompt_templates.title: Choose a basic bid strategy
prompt_templates.prompt: Choose a bid strategy for [campaign]. The goal is [goal]. We recorded [conversions] conversions in 30 days at [CPA or ROAS].
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when one campaign has clear goals and recent performance data.

prompt_templates.title: Set a starting target
prompt_templates.prompt: Calculate a starting [tCPA or tROAS] for [campaign]. Recent weekly results are [results]. Show the math and label every input source.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when the strategy is known but the initial target needs evidence.

prompt_templates.title: Build bid portfolios
prompt_templates.prompt: Group these campaigns into bid portfolios: [campaign details]. Compare goals, targets, funnel stages, and conversion volume. Explain every separation.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when several campaigns may benefit from shared conversion signals.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a learning-phase transition
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a bidding transition for [campaign set]. Include strategy eligibility, target derivation, portfolio mapping, reset risks, do-not-touch dates, and review criteria.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use for a campaign restructure or advanced account migration.

output_examples.input: Lead campaign with 90 monthly conversions and a recent CPA of $42.
output: Reason: conversion volume exceeds the estimated eligibility threshold.
Hold the target stable during the initial learning window.

output_examples.input: Ecommerce campaign with 3.8x trailing ROAS and a 4.5x goal.
output: Recommendation: start tROAS near the achieved 3.8x level.
Do not begin at the unproven 4.5x goal.
Increase the target gradually after stable learning.

output_examples.input: Four campaigns with mixed prospecting and direct-response goals.
output: Keep prospecting separate from direct-response campaigns.
Group only campaigns with comparable targets and economics.
Document assumptions for any borderline grouping.

best_practices: Provide trailing CPA or ROAS, conversion volume, campaign goals, and funnel stages.
Use achievable historical performance for the starting target.
Keep targets and budgets stable until the planned learning review.
anti_patterns: Do not invent missing conversion data or present estimates as measured facts.
Do not combine campaigns with different goals or widely different economics.
Do not jump directly from historical performance to an unsupported aspirational target.

faq.question: Which bidding strategies can this skill compare?
faq.answer: It compares tCPA, tROAS, max-conversions, max-conversion-value, manual CPC, and enhanced CPC where relevant.

faq.question: What data should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide the campaign goal, recent CPA or ROAS, conversion volume, funnel stage, current strategy, and any hard constraints.

faq.question: Can it recommend a target without history?
faq.answer: It will not invent a target. It can recommend a learning strategy without a target or request a performance export.

faq.question: Does it change bids in an advertising platform?
faq.answer: No. It creates a plan and can use optional connector data to improve the analysis.

faq.question: Does it allocate campaign budgets?
faq.answer: No. Budget allocation and live pacing are outside this skill.

faq.question: Are the learning thresholds guaranteed?
faq.answer: No. They are estimated rules of thumb, and actual platform behavior can vary.
